purpose: Test fixed importance correction of the retained main replay raw-BB objective, holding prior balanced draws and fit budget constant
criteria: Unchanged original four conditions applied only to raw-objective minus current120 on public, mixed and NoRegrets; other comparisons are diagnostics
limitations: Objective preservation concerns retained replay expected gradients before clipping and Adam, not six-player equilibrium convergence
No new self-play samples or recovery of information discarded by the51-feature encoding
Fixed original input draws and frozen scales; no importance clipping or per-batch normalization
Exploratory repeated experimentation; nominal confidence intervals are not adjusted for multiple tests
Rule-based reference opponents are not independently validated strong poker agents
No automatic model promotion or retry after a failed gate or performance condition
